API interfaces.name: api.openai.com/gpt-4.1/API1
API interfaces.description: High-accuracy model with strong reasoning. Use for precise technical tasks, debugging, and complex questions. Use API index 0.

API interfaces.name: api.openai.com/gpt-5-nano/API2
API interfaces.description: Ultra-fast and extremely low-cost model. Ideal for large document batches, chunked PDF processing, and high-volume workloads.  Use API index 1.

API interfaces.name: api.openai.com/gpt-4.1-mini/API1
API interfaces.description: Lightweight, inexpensive model. Suitable for quick rewrites, smaller tasks, and general utility work.  Use API index 2.

API interfaces.name: api.openai.com/gpt-4.1-mini/API2
API interfaces.description: Same model as gpt-4.1-mini, but via the Responses API for faster throughput when processing sequential chunks.  Use API index 3.

API interfaces.name: Google Gemini (OpenAI Legacy)
API interfaces.description: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via OpenAI-compatible endpoint. OPENAI LEGACY interface. Use API index 4.

API interfaces.name: Google Gemini (Native)
API interfaces.description: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite via native GEMINI interface. Uses x-goog-api-key auth and /models/{model}:generateContent URL. Use API index 5.

API interfaces.name: api.openai.com/gpt-4.1/MAX
API interfaces.description: Maximum reasoning quality. Slowest and most expensive option. Use for hardest problems, architecture design, and critical debugging. Use API index 6.

API interfaces.name: api.anthropic.com/claude-haiku-4-5/API4
API interfaces.description: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 via native /v1/messages endpoint. Cheapest Claude tier — good for smoke tests and high-volume throughput. Use API index 7.

API interfaces.name: api.anthropic.com/claude-opus-4-7/API4
API interfaces.description: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 via native /v1/messages endpoint. Maximum reasoning quality in the Claude family — slowest and most expensive. Use for architecture, hard debugging, and critical technical writing. Use API index 8.

API interfaces.name: api.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-4-6/API4
API interfaces.description: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 via native /v1/messages endpoint. Balanced tier — strong reasoning at moderate cost and latency. Good default for most technical work. Use API index 9.

API interfaces.name: localhost/ollama/qwen2.5-coder:32b/API1
API interfaces.description: Local Ollama qwen2.5-coder:32b via OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint. Air-gapped, no cloud cost. Use API index 10.

API interfaces.name: localhost/ollama/qwen2.5-coder:7b/API1
API interfaces.description: Local Ollama qwen2.5-coder:7b via OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint. Lighter/faster than the 32b variant. Air-gapped, no cloud cost. Use API index 11.
